name: Rogue Island Local Kitchen & Bar
tagline: Your Story with Panicci Ventures — Video Testimonial
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each — and yes, the numbers in these questions are your real numbers.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, your role at Rogue Island, and what makes the restaurant a Providence staple.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before we started working together, how did people find Rogue Island online — and what was falling through the cracks?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: Restaurants get pitched by marketers constantly. Why did you hand your online presence to Sammy and Panicci Ventures?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: What does Panicci Ventures run for you behind the scenes — the website, search, Google Business Profile, review responses?

questions.label: The Numbers
questions.text: Real numbers: Google clicks to your site more than doubled in a year — 13,900 to over 35,000, up 154% — and you showed up in searches over a million times. Did you know it was that big?

questions.label: Rankings
questions.text: When someone in Providence searches “best brunch” or “bottomless mimosas,” Rogue Island is in the top five results. How much of a packed brunch service do you credit to search?

questions.label: Reviews
questions.text: 1,208 Google reviews — and every single one of them has an answer. What does that do for a restaurant's reputation, and how much of it lands on your desk?

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's working best right now — and which result honestly surprised you the most?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from other agencies you've dealt with — communication, speed, month-to-month with no lock-in?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another restaurant owner who's great in the kitchen but invisible on Google?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures, spoken by the owner/GM of Rogue Island Local Kitchen & Bar (rogueislandgroup.com). Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. The NUMBERS, RANKINGS, and REVIEWS answers are the hero clips (real stats + reaction); RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
